status: POPULATED for calendar year 2026 only, from the NSE Equities trading-holiday list (nseindia.com Resources > Exchange Communication > Holidays; saved 2026-10-29, operator re-checked 2026-11-05). Weekend holidays are not listed in holidays (weekends are never sessions unless listed in special_sessions). special_sessions lists exceptional sessions on days that are not normal sessions: the Sunday 2026-11-08 Muhurat session. A listed special session is a required session, so its daily close must exist or orders are refused (fail closed). Operator recovery: if Breeze never serves a daily close for a special session, orders stay refused after it until the operator removes that entry from special_sessions. A date may not be both a holiday and a special session. Add 2027 before 2027-01-01: an unlisted weekday holiday makes the table expect a close that never comes, so orders are refused (fail closed), never skipped.
